lua_rendering.entity_zones: positive zoneID as exact zoneIDs.NAME from ZoneDB; no zero, sort or numeric fallback
lua_rendering.field_order: ascending consumer authoring index: remove, set, add; schema order within each group
lua_rendering.other_providers: NPC/object Load(keys, ZoneDB) when zoneID is used, otherwise Load(keys); item Load(keys)
lua_rendering.quest_categories: exact zoneIDs.NAME for positive areas or confirmed sortKeys.NAME for negative sorts; zero omitted; no numeric fallback
lua_rendering.quest_masks: exact named aggregates or sums of named individual bits; zero remains numeric
lua_rendering.quest_provider: Load(QuestieDB, ZoneDB): questKeys, raceKeys, classKeys and sortKeys from QuestieDB; zoneIDs from ZoneDB

policy.entity_zones: enrichment only for independently emitted source-validated NPCs/objects; preserve nonzero baseline and earlier values; single known positive core location, or explicit consistent zone-row location only when core absent/empty; mapper and optional fresh zone-page contradictions withhold; never select entities or change spawns
policy.item_relationships: source-only additions from nonempty tabs below 200 rows; removals report-only; selected singleton starts coordinated with quest item starters, withholding missing endpoints or scalar conflicts; target/objective overlap suppressed
policy.names: fill missing names only; preserve all existing effective pre-delta names
policy.new: absent Era registry/pages/raw base AND explicit envChange.status=new
policy.npc_reactions: enrichment only for independently emitted NPCs; own-core react [Alliance,Horde] exact integers 0/1 contribute A/H, -1 and explicit null contribute nothing; preserve every present baseline value including empty string; omit empty/unknown reactions instead of emitting empty strings or clearing fields; no faction-ID or quest inference
policy.objectives: structured objectives and triggerEnd not generated
policy.objectives_text: heading-adjacent objective summary only, with ordered lines and paragraph breaks; enrich existing or independently selected quests, never select missing quests; preserve existing text and explicit clears; absent existing fields require source-new or explicit Era change; no narrative fallback or unchanged backfill
policy.quest_category: known signed core category only; enrichment of existing or independently selected quests, never category-only selection of missing records; explicit zero retained as comparison evidence but omitted from corrections; unknown identities withheld; existing nonzero effective categories preserved; no unchanged existing-record backfill or category2/geography substitution
policy.quest_holdbacks: explicit not-in-game/deferred IDs excluded before quest selection; held quest references filtered from item export projections; no baseline deletions or inferred unavailability
policy.quest_reputation: explicit nonempty unique-faction reprewards pairs; signed amounts preserved; source-new or explicit Era changes only for existing records; changed amounts replace exact Era-matching target pairs; complete target-list replacements use plain fields, partial changes use operations; conflicting/target-only rewards preserved; missing factions never removed
policy.quest_restrictions: confirmed race/class mappings rebuilt with Forever constants; incomplete explicit masks withheld whole; narrow full-faction fallback for independently materialized quests; no existing-record backfill; last-resort race zero only for separately documented reviewed family IDs passing current evidence guards, attributed as assumptions; no general Both/None defaults or class inference
policy.relationships: positive quest giver additions; removals only with a proven move; accepted inverse edge operations
policy.spawns: missing target records only, withholding changed map frames; existing converted spawns retained
